whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Urban Vada Pav,

I noticed your outlet has strong 4.7★ reviews in Mithapur, Patna, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for fast food orders and customer inquiries.

Maine aapke food outlet ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp menu ordering, opening hours, aur location directions integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/urbanvadapav

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team Urban Vada Pav, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke business (Urban Vada Pav Mithapur) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp menu ordering, mobile-first speed, and a showcase of your location near Gauriamath Mandir in Mithapur. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept aur design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact food menu, actual photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
